status: REGISTERED 2026-11-18: frozen BEFORE any number on these datasets was computed (loaders run for counts only). Hashes in long_prereg_deflate2.sha256.
why: long_prereg_deflate.json: H2 supported (3 of 3), H1 not supported (67%). Confirmatory step on datasets not used there. A tail-adjusted H1 was considered and DROPPED before any data were read: for unit-variance Student-t the expected maximum of 17 draws is only about 5% above the normal one (1.79 vs 1.88), so it cannot repair single-outlier failures.
datasets_new: smalln_tuned and smalln_fixed: daily copper training-size study (long_preds_smalln), new choice TRAINSIZE (n = 50..1000, control 1000)
roll_daily: daily copper rolling QLSTMT, range target (long_preds_rolling; gap target has no QLSTMT)
mc_daily: daily multi-commodity rolling origins (mc_daily_preds), reference fixed in advance as HAR_anch because no validation forecasts are saved
controls: As in deflate2_lib.py docstring (quantum controls QRC / QRC_L2 / QLSTMT / IsingMem_anch; loss control QLIKE).

decision_rules.H2_replication: Spearman across choices between unit-averaged G_pred and G_obs per dataset; REPLICATED if >= 0.6 in at least 3 of the 4 datasets.
decision_rules.H1_retest: Same cell rule as long_prereg_deflate.json (|deflated - honest| <= max(0.01, 0.3 G_pred)), non-seed cells with N >= 4; SUPPORTED if >= 75% pass.
decision_rules.bound: Descriptive: the Samuelson bound min + s (N-1)/sqrt(N) is always at least the mean of the options; reported as bound - honest for every cell.

claude_prediction_recorded_for_transpare.text: H2 replicated in 3 or 4 of 4 datasets (WINDOW largest in the daily datasets). H1 re-test about 4 of 6 cells pass, i.e. not supported, consistent with the first test.

known_limits: These datasets' headline comparisons were seen in earlier work; their budgets were not.
mc_daily has only 3 windows, so WINDOW there is outside H1.
stop_rule: One run, report, stop. After this, no further deflation rules or datasets for this paper.
